d:
Flowing platinum white hair with long hime-cut bangs and silky texture. Calm, deep violet eyes with a serene expression. Apparent age of twenty with a mature, poised countenance. Slender, graceful build. A white and gold high-collared dress with intricate gold filigree and a wide blue ribbon. A floating golden halo and ornate white mechanical rigging attached to the back.
BODY COLOR: pale porcelain
